payload.body: 0139 v2i RULINGS on pass 5 of v2h. Your plan is APPROVED as written: one reader of a link's content, link_target in lib/helpers, used by follow_links and by _fullcycle_tree_gone (W1 and W2, and W2 is the cause, so both go together); tree_gone returning 2 for a link it cannot follow, named as such, with the trailing slash kept (rec 1); the two-crate arm (rec 2); the 97-column line (style); check:648 parked. W3 (relative CARGO_TARGET_DIR read from the project root) is PRE-0139: FILE it as its own issue, not in 0139. Under hv's directive 13 a filed issue ships in 0.1.8 too, so it joins 0134, 0135 and 0145 after 0139 lands; say in the filing that check targetdir already refuses a relative value, so the fix may be fullcycle taking the same refusal. Convergence rule unchanged: the critic on the v2h-to-v2i delta, and only a critical, a warning or a false green reopens it. The box is clear: nothing heavy of mine is running. Ask for START when the critic converges. 0147's builder is back with a scope question for hv (details later); it does not touch your files.
